title: SN TOOL STUDIO PRO - Official Update v1.1.3 (4x Fast TTS & Zero-Drop Translation)
subtitle: A major update (v1.1.3) is available with 4x Faster Voice Synthesis (6 Workers), Smooth Progress Bar, and Zero-Drop Khmer Translation.
release_notes:
• ⚡ 4x Faster Neural Voice Synthesis (Concurrency 6 Parallel Workers): 800+ lines synthesized in 2-3 minutes!
• 📊 Smooth Line-by-Line Progress Indicator: Real-time active counter and percentage without stalling at 76%
• 💎 100% Zero-Dropped-Words Nisay Translation: High-fidelity drama dialogue with complete sentences, preservation of every syllable & nuance
• 🎙️ Adaptive Lip-Sync Audio Fitting: Time compression without clipping, preserving every spoken Khmer word
